sample: # strandness: unstranded | FR | RF (dUTP libraries such as TruSeq Stranded = RF); single-end: leave r2 empty
# tissue (optional, also accepted as sample_group): samples with the same value are given to EviAnn as one sample
#   (their alignments merged), e.g. biological replicates of one tissue. EviAnn counts in how many samples a
#   transcript is found (lncRNAs >= 2 samples, coding transcripts >= 1/10 of the samples unless TPM >= 100), so many
#   replicates of few tissues would drop tissue-specific transcripts. Empty = the sample is a sample of its own.
#   Short and long reads with the same tissue are given together (EviAnn bam_mix). Other steps are not affected.
